sources.title: GitHub - DAXIAORobotics/kairos: Official code for world model Kairos
sources.snippet: Powered by a World-Action Model architecture and hybrid linear temporal memory, Kairos jointly predicts future visual states and executable robot actions, enabling long-horizon reasoning, high-quality generation, and real-time edge-side deployment for embodied AI.

sources.title: Models - Docs - Kiro
sources.snippet: Kiro gives you access to frontier and open weight AI models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and other providers. GPT-5.6 brings OpenAI models to Kiro for the first time, with three tiers that balance agentic performance and cost. Pick the right model for the job, or select Auto to let Kiro route each task to the optimal model automatically.
